== Summary ==
"You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]"

The Hermit isn’t really here.
* The Hermit has the abilities of all the other Outsiders on the Script, all at once. They do not have the abilities of Outsiders that are not on the script.
* If a custom script has more than 4 Outsiders, the Hermit has all these Outsider abilities.
* If one of the Outsider abilities continues after death, such as the {{Good|Recluse}}’s, the Hermit keeps that ability when they die, but does not keep their other Outsider abilities.
* A Hermit with the Drunk ability does not know that they are the Hermit, and their other Outsider abilities function as normal. A Hermit with the Recluse ability can register as a different character etc.
* If an Outsider has a jinx, that jinx applies to the Hermit too.
* The Hermit may remove the Hermit from play during setup, resulting in one less Outsider than normal. If this happens, the Hermit may still be a bluff given to the Demon.
			</div>

			<div class="small-12 large-6 columns" style="padding-right: 0;">

== How to Run ==

During setup, you may remove an Outsider token and add a Townsfolk token.

Whenever appropriate, treat the Hermit as if they are the other Outsiders, including waking them at night, and using other Outsiders’ reminder tokens. If the Hermit duplicates an in-play Outsider, use the Hermit’s '''1''', '''2''' and '''3''' reminders instead. 

<div class="example" style="color: #5d2123; font-style: italic; font-family: GoudyOldStyle;">
If Outsider abilities clash, make up a rule to fix the clash, and tell the group. For example, for a Hermit-{{Good|Butler}}-{{Good|Zealot}}, you may declare that the Hermit must vote when their master votes. 
</div>
			</div>

		<div class="small-12 large-12 columns" style="padding-right: 0;">

== Examples ==

			<div class='example'>
				Marianna is the Hermit, and has the {{Good|Klutz}}, {{Good|Butler}}, and {{Good|Recluse}} abilities. Each night, she chooses a player as her master due to the {{Good|Butler}} ability. The {{Good|Ravenkeeper}} dies and learns that she is the {{Evil|Lord of Typhon}}, due to the {{Good|Recluse}} ability. Marianna is executed, and chooses a player due to the {{Good|Klutz}} ability. She chooses the {{Evil|Wizard}}. Good loses.
			</div>

			<div class='example'>
				Lewis is the Hermit and has the {{Good|Drunk}}, {{Good|Mutant}}, and {{Good|Sweetheart}} abilities. Thinking that he is the {{Good|Exorcist}}, he chooses a player each night. Lewis says that he thinks he might be the {{Good|Drunk}}, so the Storyteller executes him due to the {{Good|Mutant}} ability. Due to the {{Good|Sweetheart}} ability, the {{Good|Alchemist}} is now drunk.
			</div>
